name: fibroblast growth factor 10

function.text: FGF10 encodes fibroblast growth factor 10. Annotated molecular activities include chemoattractant activity and growth factor activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA repair and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to lacrimoauriculodentodigital syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

selection_reason: Panel membership; user authorized the complete proposed and reserve roster.
